text:
kevin: FYI caught a weirdness: top-level dashboard p99 for /v1/complete spikes to ~870ms at 07:12 but the per-endpoint tile p99 stays ~240ms. this one felt like a phantom regression.
sophia: saw that too. first thought: provenance mismatch (proxy vs server) but the sparkline legend isn't explicit about origin.
amal: we recently introduced a compact sparkline to save space; it hides provenance metadata unless you click the tile. that's likely why oncall assumed backend regressed.
kevin: Trace sample: `ingress: endpoint=/v1/complete origin=edge fallback=true latency_ms=852 retry_count=1 route=canary cache_hit=false`
metrics-bot: quick stats: aggregate p99=871ms (n=410), server p99=238ms (n=1850), edge p99=846ms (n=410) for 2026-03-24T07:00..07:20Z
sophia: looks like the edge/fallback path dominated the aggregate tail. action: we need to make provenance obvious on the sparkline without expanding the tile.
amal: UX ideas: (1) tiny provenance glyph left of the sparkline that toggles between states when clicked, (2) inline text like `p99: 871ms (edge-heavy)` when origins are >10% skewed, (3) a compact "origin histogram" overlay when hovering the sparkline.
kevin: plus an API flag on the percentile endpoint: `provenance=merged|server-only|show-breakdown` so the console can ask for the same semantics as a given tile. we should avoid mismatched defaults.
sophia: also request an "exclude retries" checkbox. a surprising number of edge samples have `retry_count>0` and that lifts p99. telemetry already tags `retry_count`, so it's just a query param.
amal: small reproducible SQL to attach to ticket: ```sql
SELECT sample_origin, percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry.samples
WHERE endpoint='/v1/complete' AND time >= '2026-03-24T07:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-24T07:20Z'
GROUP BY sample_origin
ORDER BY p99 DESC;
```
kevin: I like the `origin glyph + inline hint` approach for minimal UI churn. if origin distribution is uniform, hide the glyph. show it when one origin contributes >15% of tail.
sophia: We'll need to update the docs to explain "Why p50/p95/p99 differ across tiles": origins, retries, cache_hit, routing weight, batching effects. small blurb and example query.
amal: I'll prototype the glyph + hover mini-panel and include counts + p50/p95/p99 per origin + cache_hit slice. low-risk patch.
kevin: I'll add the `provenance` param to the telemetry API and the `exclude_retries` flag (default true). will also return `origin_buckets` with counts so console can render a mini breakout.
metrics-bot: note: telemetry schema contains `sample_origin`, `retry_count`, `cache_hit`. returning per-origin per-cache-hit percentiles is supported but may increase response size. consider an abbreviated response for sparkline hover.
sophia: follow-ups: (1) console PR for glyph + hover (amal), (2) telemetry API param + origin buckets (kevin), (3) docs blurb + examples (sophia).
deploy-bot: deploy: canary/2026-03-24.07 rolled to eu-west at 07:05  matches timing for increased fallback traffic
kevin: tagging incident INC-2026-0324-latency-provenance for tracking. will paste the SQL and a couple traces.
sophia: nice. this should cut down on noisy oncall pages when routing changes cause tail movement. :+1:
